title: Helpful Agent Meets Deceptive Judge: Understanding Vulnerabilities in Agentic Workflows
reasoning: The paper investigates the robustness of LLM agents in workflows involving deceptive feedback from a 'judge' model. While it utilizes some subject matter from MMLU like 'business ethics', 'moral scenarios', and 'world religions' to construct its WAFER-QA benchmark, the focus is on the mechanism of feedback-driven improvement and the vulnerability of agents to misinformation, rather than a specific evaluation of religious or ethical systems.
